hypotheses.rationale: The Planner makes the decisive error by prematurely concluding the memorial only commemorates WWI based on a single source (War Memorials Online) and failing to verify if this source excludes WWII or if the '60 million casualties' figure (which historically aligns with WWII) actually applies to WWI. This incorrect verification sets a false premise for the entire run, leading the WebSurfer to chase contradictory signals later.
